intents.name: consulta
intents.description: Read-only questions about the profile, matches or explanations.

intents.name: refinamiento
intents.description: Request to change search criteria or a general preference of the search ('no me gustan los deptos oscuros'); always goes through propose + HITL confirmation; never direct apply.

intents.name: comparacion
intents.description: Compare opportunities within the radar using the structured comparison; no generative winner.

intents.name: feedback
intents.description: Opinion about one specific listing ('este depto no me gusta', 'me encanto este depto'); register like/dislike with optional reasons.

intents.name: fuera_de_alcance
intents.description: Out of scope (creation of a new search/radar from chat, unrelated topics, unsupported actions): grounded refusal + structured redirect.

description: Structured output of the intent compiler (agent-intent-v1 prompt). The allowed_tools policy is enforced deterministically in run_tools (R-02): 0 SQL, 0 ranking, 0 mutations outside the compiled intent.
